instrument.title: EU AI Act

instrument.composition_warning: This is an UNOFFICIAL composed text. No official consolidated version of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended has been published. Label it as a composition wherever it is used.
instrument.republishable_basis: EU legislative texts are freely reusable; source is official Formex XML from CELLAR

provenance.source_authority: CELLAR (Publications Office of the European Union)
provenance.parsing: deterministic; every node carries a SHA-256 of the retrieved bytes
known_weaknesses: Article-level readings and the operator question set are derived from SECONDARY sources rather than a clause-by-clause reading of the operative text. Re-derivation is required before any citation here is relied on.
The vault has 2 commits and carries no amendment-over-time history; 2026/1744 is composed in rather than tracked as a change.
The Article 99 third penalty tier is internally disputed (1% vs 1.5%) and is deliberately not published.

citation_scheme.alias_form: zero-padded, e.g. art-026-para-05, art-009-para-05-pt-d, rec-060, anx-III-pt-05-b
citation_scheme.note: The alias is a projection of the positional hash. If the instrument renumbers, the alias moves and the hash does not.

epistemic_rule: An agent may report which provision a claim points at. It may not report that a requirement is met. This site produces findings and unanswered questions, never a score, never a pass.

crosswalks.note: No bridge exists from this instrument to any other. Not to GDPR, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001 or NIST AI RMF. The design is at /method/crosswalks.html; the bridges are not built.
